hook: Govt caps fine rice at *₹66–79/kg*, down from *₹90* in shops
hook_b: Rice was ₹90/kg. Will the new *₹79* cap bring it down?
tldr: Update Oct 31: the Telangana government has announced a maximum retail price for three fine rice varieties, between ₹66 and ₹79 a kg. Fine (sanna) rice had climbed from about ₹45 to over ₹90 a kg in Hyderabad and villages amid El Niño, pre-booking and hoarding cases.

beats.what: Open-market paddy prices jumped to ₹3,000–3,500 a quintal. Buyers are pre-booking harvests; one Vikarabad buyer paid ₹5,000 a quintal in advance.
beats.why: El Niño dried up water, the government is asking farmers not to sow rabi paddy, and people expect a shortage. CID also arrested 14 millers for diverting fine paddy and passing off coarse rice to FCI.
beats.care: If your shop charges above the new ₹66–79 MRP for these fine rice varieties, you are paying more than the government cap. Check the variety and the rate before you buy a bag.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new (Oct 31)
cards.body: The Telangana government announced an MRP for three fine rice varieties: ₹66 to ₹79 a kg (The Hindu). That is well below the ₹90+ readers were seeing in shops. Variety-wise rates and enforcement details weren't in the headline we could verify.

cards.caption: per kg of fine rice now
cards.body: Was about ₹45. Buyers in Hyderabad, Khammam and Vikarabad fear it could reach ₹100.

cards.caption: avg retail rice in Telangana, May–July
cards.body: Nearly ₹10/kg above the national average, per Union Consumer Affairs data reported in July. Experts then blamed hoarding as well as El Niño.

Farmers who struggled to sell at procurement centres last season now have buyers coming to them. Selling at the PPC means 10 days of drying from 35% to 17% moisture, so many sell wet paddy straight to the open market.

cards.q: Has your rice or grocery bill gone up this month?

learn.t: MSP (minimum support price) is the floor the government pays for crops. When open-market prices beat MSP, less grain reaches the government's ration stock.

watch: Variety-wise MRP list and how it is enforced at shops; action on hoarding traders (6 booked Oct 31); harvest arrivals through December.
